basic_details.job_title: GFGNL Junior Technical Engineer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: GFGNL is hiring a Junior Technical Engineer (Districts) at Gandhinagar on a remuneration of INR 35400/- P.M. (Cost to Company basis). The essential qualification is B.E./B.Tech. in Electronics & Communications, Electronics & Telecommunications, Electrical, Computer or Information Technology with First Class, and the age must be not more than 32 years. Applications are taken through the Apply Now option on the job page from 17 November 2026, 13:03 to 1 December 2026, 15:00.

how_to_apply: The notice shows an Apply Now option on the Junior Technical Engineer (Districts) job page. Applications can be made from 17 November 2026, 13:03 until 1 December 2026, 15:00. The notice gives no further application steps, fee details or list of documents.

content_sections.heading: About GFGNL
content_sections.text: The notice is a job page published under the name GFGNL. The post is linked to fibre optic infrastructure work: supporting the deployment and construction of fibre networks and their day-to-day installation and maintenance. The location is given as Gandhinagar, and the notice states that the position is district based.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Age limit: not more than 32 years. The notice prints no cut-off date for counting age and no age relaxation. The notice lists the following under the "Desired Profile": Experience of minimum 3 years in working on Telecom/IT projects. Expertise in providing technical support for deployment and construction of fibre optic infrastructure. Expertise in deployment of active and passive networking devices. Expertise in managing and maintenance of cables and networks. Soft skills named in the notice: ability to liaise with project stakeholders, excellent listening skills, and excellent verbal and written communication skills. Candidates should check the official notice on the GFGNL job page for any further post-specific eligibility.

rows.essential_qualification: B.E./B.Tech. in Electronics & Communications / Electronics & Telecommunications / Electrical / Computer / Information Technology with First Class from reputed institute / university

content_sections.heading: Pay
content_sections.text: The remuneration is INR 35400/- P.M. on a Cost to Company basis. The notice does not mention any allowance on top of this amount.

content_sections.heading: GFGNL Junior Technical Engineer (Districts) Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists these key roles and responsibilities: Closely monitor and supervise the day to day installation and maintenance work of fibre network and infrastructure. Maintain strong relationship working with the Utility business implementing the fibre construction project and on-going maintenance of fibre infrastructure. Interface with and manage vendor partners supporting the construction of the fibre infrastructure. Participate in IT architecture review and standards setting. Lead the development of Design Standards, white papers, and conduct presentations as needed to explain why a technology is being recommended by IT. Locate problem areas and perform necessary corrective action as needed. Determine solutions for any issues preventing the service from operating normally. Provide support by diagnosing network and device related problems and implementing technical or procedural solutions. Coordinate properly with stakeholders / management for smooth functioning of the project. Support in monitoring / help establish a suitable network/IT infrastructure monitoring system at the State level. The notice also states that the position is district based.

content_sections.text: The notice shows an Apply Now option on the Junior Technical Engineer (Districts) job page. Applications can be made from 17 November 2026, 13:03 until 1 December 2026, 15:00. The notice gives no further application steps, fee details or list of documents.
